# Explainer artwork

Four original transparent PNG assets were generated using the built-in ImageGen tool: clay laptop, clay phone, realistic laptop and realistic phone. Generation prompts and filenames are in GENERATION.json. The original outputs are retained in the Codex generated-images folder; these project copies are bundled for local use.

The 24 shaded 2D illustrations are original Canvas artwork in dist/explainer-assets.js. Vector detail animation is drawn at playback/export time. An embedded transparent PNG fallback travels with each placed vector object. Cut-outs retain their original PNG pixels and use whole-object motion.
